records.description: The 101 Secrets in pink gold captivates. At first glance, no one would guess that beneath its bracelet, adorned with over a thousand diamonds, lies an invisible miniaturized button. A simple press and two sections open to reveal an exquisite mother-of-pearl dial, giving the owner the freedom to look at the time whenever they choose. Featuring over 1'000 diamonds, this exceptional timepiece is set to the finest detail. The craftsmen at the Atelier des Métiers Rares have combined two gem-setting techniques requiring more than 182 hours of work. Griffe setting on the outer rows, and grain setting on the inner rows and on the sides, a veritable halo of light. At the heart of the 101 Secrets, the in-house calibre 101 features 98 components and weighs less than a gram.

records.description: With precision inspired by the stars, the iconic OMEGA Constellation is characterised by its famous case with half-moon facets, and the polished claws that grip to the sides. This 25 mm model is crafted in polished stainless steel and features a polished bezel with Roman numerals engraved. The sun-brushed silvery white dial creates an elegant backdrop, while other details include polished and skeletonized 18K Sedna™ Gold hands and star at six o’clock, and hour markers in polished 18K Sedna™ Gold. The watch is presented on a signature polished mono-rang bracelet with easy comfort-adjustment, and is powered by the OMEGA Calibre 4061, which sits behind a stamped Constellation Observatory medallion on the caseback.

records.short_description: With self-winding movement and a two-tone beige dial, the Aquanaut Luce Haute Joaillerie 5072R is a unique watch for women.
records.description: The engraved mother-of-pearl dial of this Aquanaut Luce Joaillerie features a two-tone checkerboard pattern in subtle shades of beige, lit up by the baguette-cut diamonds set on the bezel. The rose gold case enhanced by contrasting polished and satin-brushed finishes houses a self-winding movement visible through a transparent sapphire case-back.
